connections.why: Philosophical questions about God and evil inform how religious ethical theories are framed
The arguments and problem of evil are the substance of the philosophy-religion dialogue
Normative theories provide the content for the dialogue between ethics and religion
The systematic study supplies the religious tradition that engages with philosophy
The chosen religion's teachings are tested against ethical theory
Both dialogues apply the same method of bringing external thought to bear on religious tradition
